faq: Will you change my live site straight away?
No. We duplicate the project or use a staging branch, make the changes there and send you a preview link. Only after you approve do we publish, so visitors never see half-finished work.
Can you edit a template I bought?
Yes, as long as the template license allows changes, which standard Webflow templates do. We keep the original structure where possible and tell you if a request would fight the template's design.
What if my request is bigger than the package?
We tell you before starting. You can pick the next package, trim the list or keep the extras for a later order. Nothing is added to your price without your written yes.
Do I need to give you my login?
No. Add us as a collaborator or workspace member from your Webflow settings. We never ask for your password and you can remove our access whenever the work is done.
